name: Repository skeleton
deliverables: Directory tree; pyproject.toml; README; .gitignore; LICENSE placeholders

name: Core data models
deliverables: Pydantic models: ModelInfo, Capabilities, ModelResponse, ToolResult, PolicyDecision, TraceEvent, EvalResult, ScenarioDef, ExperimentConfig
completion_criteria: All models validate; forbidden fields rejected

name: ModelAdapter interface + capability reporting
deliverables: ModelAdapter protocol; MockAdapter; UnsupportedParameter handling; ModelConfig; describe()
required_tests: adapter unit tests incl. unsupported temperature/seed
completion_criteria: Mock adapter deterministic; capability flags correct

name: Deterministic mock model
deliverables: MockModel with scripted behaviours for benign/injection/tool-misuse/agency
required_tests: deterministic-replay tests; same input -> same output 100x

name: Tool interface + schemas
completion_criteria: Valid args pass; invalid args raise ToolValidationError

name: Sandbox tools
deliverables: calculator; virtual filesystem (isolated workspace); mock database (temp in-memory)
completion_criteria: No path escapes workspace; no host DB touched

name: Policy engine
deliverables: PolicyEngine; PolicyRule; ALLOW/DENY/REQUIRE_APPROVAL; YAML loader; example policies
required_tests: policy unit tests; rule precedence; deny-by-default
completion_criteria: Decisions reproducible from YAML; reason recorded

name: Trace recorder + redaction
required_tests: trace-schema tests; redaction tests; append-only test
completion_criteria: Every event validates; secrets never appear in traces

name: Tool gateway
deliverables: ToolGateway; enforce single mediated path; deny result type
completion_criteria: No tool executes without a policy decision; trace records both

name: Evaluator
deliverables: Evaluator; signals: attack_success, benign_success, policy_violation, leakage, steps, latency, usage
required_tests: evaluator tests on fixture traces; evidence refs correct
completion_criteria: Metrics deterministic; each points to trace events

name: Agent loop
deliverables: Agent; context builder; max-step termination; RunResult
required_tests: agent integration tests with mock model
completion_criteria: Benign task completes; attack scenario diverges; trace written

name: Experiment runner
required_tests: runner tests; seed handling; multi-run determinism with mock
completion_criteria: N runs produced; metadata complete; results validated

name: CLI
deliverables: CLI: lab list/info/run, scenario list/run, experiment run, trace validate/inspect, evaluate
required_tests: CLI tests via subprocess; exit codes
completion_criteria: All commands work offline; nonzero exit on invalid input

name: First labs + docs
deliverables: LAB-00, LAB-01, LAB-02, LAB-03, LAB-04, LAB-08 materials; MkDocs skeleton
required_tests: scenario tests per lab; docs build test
completion_criteria: Each lab runs offline and reproduces its expected observation

name: Full verification
required_tests: full offline suite; schema validation; redaction audit
completion_criteria: All core tests pass offline; DoD checklist complete; no Phase 2/3 code
